svg.title: Design sheet · Vine bracelet
svg.text: Back of the left hand and forearm. Trace the gray vine, leaves and flower; the vine leaves one edge and comes back on the other. Lesson 10.2.
Must measure 10 cm. If not, print at 100% ("Actual size").
Order: lead lines, vines, leaves, flowers, highlights and dots. Right-handed? Paint your left hand, as drawn here.
